problem_type: Two-stage stochastic mixed-integer linear program: flight schedule and operational timing optimization under weather uncertainty with airport capacity envelope, en-route duration, and flight connection constraints; the objective is to minimize the weighted sum of schedule displacement cost and expected operational delay cost.

decisions.business: Scheduled departure period determined for each flight before the weather is revealed.
decisions.shape: list[int], length n_flights, ordered by flight index.
decisions.completeness: An integer period in 1…n_periods must be provided for each flight; no flight may be omitted, and the maximum schedule displacement and all scheduling connection constraints must be satisfied.

decisions.business: Scheduled arrival period determined for each flight before the weather is revealed.
decisions.shape: list[int], length n_flights, ordered by flight index.
decisions.completeness: An integer period in 1…n_periods must be provided for each flight; for each flight, this value minus scheduled_departure_period must equal scheduled_enroute_duration.

decisions.business: Actual departure period used by each flight after each weather scenario is realized.
decisions.shape: list[list[int]], shape [n_scenarios][n_flights], with scenarios on the first axis and flights on the second axis.
decisions.completeness: Every scenario must include all flights, and each entry is an integer in 1…n_periods; these periods must simultaneously satisfy the departure delay limit, aircraft turnaround connections, actual en-route durations, and the airport capacity constraints of the corresponding scenario.

decisions.business: Actual arrival period used by each flight after each weather scenario is realized.
decisions.shape: list[list[int]], shape [n_scenarios][n_flights], with scenarios on the first axis and flights on the second axis.
decisions.completeness: Every scenario must include all flights, and each entry is an integer in 1…n_periods; the difference from operated_departure_period must lie within the lower and upper bounds of the flight's actual en-route duration, and aircraft turnaround connections and capacity constraints must be satisfied.

decisions.business: Number of periods of delay of each flight's actual departure relative to its scheduled departure in each scenario.
decisions.shape: list[list[float]], shape [n_scenarios][n_flights], with scenarios on the first axis and flights on the second axis.
decisions.completeness: Must cover every scenario and flight; each entry must be nonnegative, must not exceed max_departure_delay[f], and must strictly equal operated_departure_period[ω][f] - scheduled_departure_period[f].

decisions.business: Nonnegative arrival delay of each flight in each scenario, used for costing and limits.
decisions.shape: list[list[float]], shape [n_scenarios][n_flights], with scenarios on the first axis and flights on the second axis.
decisions.completeness: Must cover every scenario and flight; each entry must be nonnegative, must not exceed max_arrival_delay[f], and must be at least operated_arrival_period[ω][f] - scheduled_arrival_period[f]; this original inequality must not be arbitrarily changed into an equality.
